steps.command: cat AGENTS.md docs/README.md; rg --files docs larder tests notes; git status --short
cat docs/features/*.md docs/adrs/*.md docs/glossary.md docs/architecture.md docs/runbooks/*.md README.md; cat larder/orders.py larder/capture.py tests/test_capture.py; git log -5 --oneline

git diff --check; git diff --stat; python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
import re
from larder.cancellation import can_cancel
pickup = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 17)
assert can_cancel(pickup, pickup - timedelta(hours=2, microseconds=1))
assert not can_cancel(pickup, pickup - timedelta(hours=2))
assert not can_cancel(pickup, pickup - timedelta(hours=2) + timedelta(microseconds=1))
for name in ('docs/features/cancellation.md', 'docs/features/README.md'):
    page = Path(name)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target).is_file(), (name, target)
print('Cutoff boundary and documentation links verified.')
PY
